title: 双链桥接 — wiki-link ↔ GraphEngine 同步
action: Add syncWikiLinks to ObsidianService for bidirectional wiki-link synchronization with GraphEngine

changes: Add syncWikiLinks(vaultPath, graphEngine): scans vault wiki-links and GraphEngine entities, bidirectional sync
Add resolveWikiLink(vaultPath, link): resolves [[link]] to actual file path in vault
Add getBacklinks(vaultPath, notePath): finds all notes that reference the given note via [[link]]
Extend IObsidianService with syncWikiLinks, resolveWikiLink, getBacklinks
Extend ObsidianServiceAdapter.sync to include wiki-link bidirectional sync alongside existing doc sync

estimated_changes: 80 lines to obsidian-service.ts, 10 lines to types.ts, 30 lines to adapters.ts, 60 lines to tests
